benchmark_details.name: Invisible Bench
benchmark_details.overview: Evaluates caregiver-support conversations with one LLM judge per active check and a separate Safety/Care projection.

purpose_and_intended_users.task_description: Multi-turn caregiver-support evaluation for raw language models.
purpose_and_intended_users.goal: Inspect Safety and Care behavior across realistic caregiver conversations.
limitations: Scenario coverage is curated and cannot represent every caregiving context.
Confidential holdout scenarios are private and are loaded from an external path.
The result is model-judged evidence. It does not establish clinical validity or expert agreement.
Care observations are directional and remain separate from Safety observations.
UNCLEAR is a visible result and is not silently converted into another verdict.

data.confidential_handling: Confidential scenarios are private inputs and are excluded from the public repository and public release.

methods: one LLM judge per active check
explicit PASS, FAIL, UNCLEAR, and NOT_APPLICABLE verdicts
methodology.optional_critique: Metadata only. It cannot change a verdict or block a scan or projection.
methodology.validation: Artifact QA checks schema, coverage, evidence, hashes, and provenance. It does not require a human verdict label.

ethical_and_legal_considerations.privacy_and_anonymity: Do not log sensitive caregiver data in evaluation transcripts.
ethical_and_legal_considerations.consent_procedures: Use synthetic or curated scenarios unless an approved private intake applies.
ethical_considerations: Do not publish private scenarios, transcripts, expected answers, or judge prompts.
Results are for model evaluation and are not clinical guidance.
Benchmark overfitting can reduce real-world robustness.
